jobs.title: Drug Safety Physician
jobs.description:
The purpose of Idorsia is to discover, develop and commercialize innovative medicines to help more patients. To achieve this, we will develop Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

We are seeking an  established Drug Safety Physician  with extensive pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry experience to lead safety activities for assigned products across development and post-marketing phases. The successful candidate will bring deep expertise in pharmacovigilance, signal management, benefit-risk assessment, and regulatory safety reporting, combined with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and engage effectively with global health authorities.

This is an opportunity to make a significant impact on patient safety while serving as a key medical safety leader within our Global Drug Safety organization

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE

• Doctor of Medicine degree with substantial experience in global drug safety within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry

• Full understanding of post-marketing adverse experience reporting systems, experience in product safety monitoring and preparation of post-marketing regulatory safety reports/documents

• Excellent medical writing and presentation skills

• Excellent interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills

• Excellent organizational and planning capabilities and ability to meet timelines

RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

• Accountable for all aspects of safety related primarily to assigned marketed products

• Acts as responsible DSP assigned to projects in early development

• Leads the cross-functional Safety Management Team (SMT) for assigned products; responsible for the integration, analysis, and interpretation of safety information from all sources, including preclinical throughout life cycle product management.

• Coordinates and ensures good quality presentation by the SMT at Idorsia Drug Safety Committee (DSC), with an accurate review of the safety profile of the product including presentation of implemented safety measures and SMT recommendations

• Responsible for overall signal detection, monitoring, evaluation, interpretation and appropriate management of safety information

• Responsible for the preparation of aggregated periodic safety reports (DSUR, PSUR/PBRER), Reference Safety Information (RSI) section of the Investigator Brochure (IB) and contributes to other key regulatory key safety documents such as RMP

• Responsible for medical review of adverse event reports received from all sources for assigned projects/products to ensure proper coding, seriousness, expectedness and causality assessment and request medically relevant follow up information for proper documentation and evaluation of the cases

• Responsible for responses on safety inquiries from regulatory authorities

• Supports the management of regulatory Heath Authority inspections

What we offer

• Strategic impact : play a key role in shaping product safety strategies across development and commercialized products

• Scientific leadership : collaborate with experienced internal and external experts on complex safety challenges

• Global environment : work in a highly international organization with broad cross-functional exposure

Work  Location: Allschwil, Switzerland

Business Area:  Global Drug Safety

Job Type: Permanent, full time

Job ID : 4838

QUALIFICHE E ESPERIENZE RICHIESTE

• Dottore in medicina con esperienza sostanziale nella sicurezza globale dei farmaci nell'industria farmaceutica o biotecnologica

• Piena comprensione dei sistemi di segnalazione delle esperienze avverse post-marketing, esperienza nel monitoraggio della sicurezza dei prodotti e preparazione di relazioni/documenti di sicurezza regolamentari post-marketing

• Ottime abilità di scrittura e presentazione medica

• Eccellenti capacità interpersonali, di comunicazione e di negoziazione

• Ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione e capacità di soddisfare le scadenze

RISPONSIBILITA' E COMPITI

• Tenuto conto di tutti gli aspetti della sicurezza connessi principalmente ai prodotti commercializzati assegnati

• Atti come DSP responsabile assegnati ai progetti in fase di sviluppo precoce

• guida il team di gestione della sicurezza (SMT) cross-funzionale per i prodotti assegnati; responsabile dell'integrazione, analisi e interpretazione delle informazioni sulla sicurezza da tutte le fonti, compresa la gestione del prodotto del programma del programma per tutto il ciclo di vita.

• coordina e garantisce una presentazione di buona qualità da parte della SMT presso il Comitato per la sicurezza dei farmaci dell'Idorsia (DSC), con un'accurata revisione del profilo di sicurezza del prodotto, compresa la presentazione delle misure di sicurezza attuate e delle raccomandazioni della SMT

• Responsabile del rilevamento, del monitoraggio, della valutazione, dell'interpretazione e della gestione delle informazioni sulla sicurezza in generale

• Responsabile della preparazione di relazioni periodiche aggregate sulla sicurezza (DSUR, PSUR/PBRER), sezione Informazioni sulla sicurezza di riferimento (RSI) dello studioso Brochure (IB) e contribuisce ad altri documenti chiave di sicurezza normativi come il RMP

• Responsabile della revisione medica delle segnalazioni di eventi avversi ricevute da tutte le fonti per progetti/prodotti assegnati per garantire la corretta codifica, gravità, attesa e valutazione della causalità e richiedere informazioni di follow-up clinicamente rilevanti per la documentazione e la valutazione dei casi

• Responsabile delle risposte alle inchieste di sicurezza da parte delle autorità di regolamentazione

• Supporta la gestione delle ispezioni dell'Autorità di Heath

Cosa offriamo

• Impatto strategico: svolgere un ruolo chiave nella definizione delle strategie di sicurezza dei prodotti tra lo sviluppo e i prodotti commercializzati

• Leadership scientifica: collaborare con esperti esperti interni ed esterni sulle complesse sfide in materia di sicurezza

• Ambiente globale: lavoro in un'organizzazione altamente internazionale con ampia esposizione cross-funzionale

Luogo di lavoro: Allschwil, Svizzera

Area di attività: Sicurezza globale della droga

Nous recherchons un médecin en sécurité des médicaments ayant une vaste expérience de l'industrie pharmaceutique ou de la biotechnologie pour diriger les activités d'innocuité des produits attribués durant les phases de développement et de post-commercialisation. Le candidat retenu apportera une expertise approfondie en matière de pharmacovigilance, de gestion des signaux, d'évaluation des avantages et des risques et de rapports d'innocuité réglementaires, ainsi que la capacité d'influencer les équipes interfonctionnelles et de collaborer efficacement avec les autorités sanitaires mondiales.

C'est l'occasion d'avoir un impact important sur la sécurité des patients tout en servant de chef de file en matière de sécurité médicale au sein de notre organisation mondiale de la sécurité des médicaments.

QUALIFICATIONS ET EXPÉRIENCES REQUISES

• Doctorat en médecine ayant une expérience importante de l'innocuité des médicaments au niveau mondial dans l'industrie pharmaceutique ou de la biotechnologie

jobs.title: Senior Clinical Pharmacologist
jobs.description:
The purpose of Idorsia is to challenge accepted medical paradigms, answering the questions that matter most. To achieve this, we will discover, develop, and commercialize transformative medicines – either with in-house capabilities or together with partners – and evolve Idorsia into a leading biopharmaceutical company, with a strong scientific core.

We are seeking an experienced, entrepreneurial  Senior Clinical Pharmacologist to join our organization. In this role, you will operate in a lean, fast-paced environment with established core processes and systems, influencing the clinical pharmacology strategy across a high volume of First-in-Human (FIH) and early clinical programs , as well as ongoing studies.

This is a hands-on, high-impact role within Global Clinical Development, offering significant visibility and growth potential in the organization, and requiring close collaboration with Translational Research.

Key Responsibilities

• Lead the design and execution of clinical pharmacology strategies and corresponding studies across multiple programs,

• Develop innovative and meaningful clinical pharmacology approaches that accelerate and de-risk drug development

• Define dose selection, escalation strategies, and characterize exposure-response relationships

• Ensure integration of nonclinical, translational, biomarker and clinical data to inform development decisions

• Design clinical studies with appropriate pharmacokinetic (PK) and pharmacodynamic (PD) endpoints

• Apply biomarkers and model-informed drug development (MIDD) approaches to enhance study design and decision-making

• Author and contribute to protocol development, including statistical and modeling/simulation considerations

• Serve as the primary clinical pharmacology interface with: Research, Translational Sciences, Biostatistics, Regulatory Affairs

• Represent clinical pharmacology at life cycle meetings

• Lead scientific discussions and provide strategic input in program governance meetings and decision-making forums

• Manage a large inflow of new clinical candidates alongside ongoing studies

• Author and contribute to regulatory documentation (IND/CTA, briefing documents, health authority responses)

• Represent clinical pharmacology in agency interactions as a subject matter expert

• Manage and oversee external partners (CROs, modeling vendors)

Qualifications & Experience

• PhD, PharmD, MD, or equivalent in Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacokinetics, or related field

• 10+ years of job relevant industry experience in biotech/pharma

• Proven track record in:

• Early clinical development (FIH through proof-of-concept)

• Study design and dose justification

• PK/PD modeling and interpretation

• Experience managing multiple concurrent programs in a dynamic environment

• Entrepreneurial mindset and intellectual curiosity with ability to thrive in ambiguity and rapid change

• Strong scientific leadership with a hands-on, execution-oriented approach

• Demonstrated ability to translate clinical pharmacology data into high-quality manuscripts, abstracts, and conference presentations

• Excellent cross-functional collaboration and influencing skills

• Ability to balance strategic thinking with operational delivery

Are you an experienced clinical development professional eager to take scientific ownership of a clinical program and help shape the future of a differentiated therapy?

We are seeking a scientifically curious, strategic and hands-on  Clinical Development Lead to provide clinical and scientific leadership across the design, execution and interpretation of clinical studies. In this role, you will play a central role in translating scientific insight into high-quality clinical evidence and development decisions that can make a meaningful difference for patients.

This role offers the opportunity to shape lifecycle evidence generation and unlock the full potential of differentiated medicines through clinically meaningful, scientifically robust and strategically aligned development activities.

Working closely with Clinical Operations, Regulatory Affairs, Drug Safety, Biostatistics, Medical Affairs and Commercial colleagues, you will ensure development plans are scientifically robust, operationally feasible and strategically aligned. This is an opportunity to combine scientific depth with visible cross-functional leadership in an entrepreneurial, collaborative and fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

The Clinical Development Lead is the clinical and scientific expert responsible for leading the delivery of clinical program objectives for an assigned compound, in line with Company strategy and agreed development plans.

Main responsibilities include:

• Lead the multidisciplinary Clinical Team at development-program level, providing scientific direction, strategic alignment and accountability across the program.

• Shape innovative clinical development strategies that maximize the compound's value throughout its lifecycle, integrating emerging scientific evidence and evolving standard of care into development plans.

• Lead the scientific development and delivery of clinical sections of trial- and program-level regulatory documents, including Investigator’s Brochures, briefing books, safety updates, submission dossiers and responses to Health Authorities.

• Provide thought leadership in clinical trial design and execution in close partnership with key functions, ensuring scientific quality, clear prioritisation and timely delivery.

• Provide ongoing clinical and scientific review, interpretation and communication of clinical trial data to inform program strategy and development decisions.

• Serve as a core member of the Safety Management Team and contribute to the assessment and communication of the compound’s benefit-risk profile.

• Support the preparation of safety-related documents, including Periodic Safety Update Reports, Drug Safety Update Reports and other safety documentation, in collaboration with the Project Physician and Drug Safety Physician.

• Maintain a strong understanding of the therapeutic area, competitive landscape, relevant mechanisms of action and evolving standards of care.

• Lead clinical contributions to scientific communications, including study abstracts, posters, oral presentations and manuscripts.

• Represent the Company as a credible scientific leader externally with investigators, scientific experts, advisory boards and Health Authorities.

• Champion the clinical perspective in cross-functional discussions and support the continuous evolution of the clinical development strategy.

Candidate Requirements

• Advanced degree in life or health sciences, such as PhD, MD, PharmD, MSc or equivalent.

Siamo ora alla ricerca di un ricercatore postdoctoral altamente motivato in Biologia del CNS/Pharmacology per aderire al nostro Gruppo di Scienze Biologiche

Responsabilità del lavoro

Per rafforzare i nostri sforzi di caratterizzazione della biologia e della biologia delle malattie in biologia/farmacologia del CNS, offriamo una posizione Postdoc per un neurobiologo altamente motivato. Il candidato di successo avrà una solida esperienza con coculture neuronali derivate da hiPSC, così come la conoscenza di base della modellazione e dell'analisi dei circuiti neuronali. In questo ruolo si indaga l'effetto di agenti terapeutici innovativi nei modelli di co-cultura neuronale della malattia utilizzando una vasta gamma di riletture. Si completa questo con i dati generati in modelli di malattia in vivo.

Le responsabilità includono:

• Progettare, eseguire, analizzare e interpretare esperimenti in coculture neuronali derivate da iPSC per caratterizzare agenti terapeutici innovativi per la scoperta di farmaci CNS

• Impostare e ottimizzare le analisi di elettrofisiologia, omica, biochimica e immunocitochimica delle coculture neuronali per gli studi di meccanismo di azione

• Introdurre mutazioni causate dalle malattie nelle cellule iPSC (CRISPR) per generare e caratterizzare modelli di malattia basati sulla co-cultura per esperimenti precedenti

• Progettazione, eseguire, analizzare e interpretare gli esperimenti nei modelli di malattia CNS roditore

About the Company

We are now looking for a highly motivated  Postdoctoral Researcher in the Drug Metabolism and Pharmacokinetics (DMPK) section of our Nonclinical Development department (2 years).

Job Responsibilities

• Establish and evaluate New Approach Methodologies (NAMs) such as advanced in vitro hepatic systems to improve the prediction of human clearance, with a particular focus on low-turnover compounds.

• Compare intrinsic clearance data generated in conventional systems, such as human liver microsomes and cryopreserved hepatocytes, with data from more complex liver-cell models such as HepaRG, HepatoPac, TruVivo or related systems.

• Develop and apply robust LC-MS/MS bioanalytical methods to quantify parent compound depletion and, where appropriate, metabolite formation in those assays.

• Investigate the impact of nonspecific binding, compound stability, incubation recovery and free concentration on the interpretation of clearance data and support in vitro–in vivo extrapolation in collaboration with DMPK modelers.

• Assess the suitability of advanced hepatic systems for drug-metabolizing enzyme phenotyping in comparison with human liver microsomes, integrating metabolite identification where appropriate.

• Document, analyze and present experimental results in multidisciplinary project teams, and contribute to scientific reports, internal presentations, conference communications and peer-reviewed publications.

Candidate’s Requirements

• PhD in pharmaceutical sciences, analytical chemistry, biochemistry, biology, pharmacology or a related discipline, with solid scientific training and a strong interest in applying experimental and analytical skills to DMPK questions.

• Hands-on experience with cell culture and LC-MS/MS bioanalysis is required; experience with high-resolution MS and/or metabolite identification is an advantage.

• Experience with in vitro ADME/DMPK assays, such as microsomal or hepatocyte stability, protein binding, drug-metabolizing enzyme phenotyping, is desirable.

• Good understanding of drug metabolism, hepatic clearance mechanisms, enzyme phenotyping and in vitro–in vivo extrapolation, or strong motivation to develop expertise in these areas.

• Proactive, collaborative and reliable personality with strong analytical thinking, excellent organizational and communication skills, and the ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary and multicultural environment.

• Ability to independently manage and coordinate multiple providers, deadlines, requests and projects simultaneously in a complex international environment

• Experience in payroll process design and continuous improvement is an advantage.

• An innovative and open culture in a truly multicultural and international environment

• A competitive salary and attractive social benefits

Stiamo cercando uno specialista senior in buste paga (Svizzera, UE e I) da inserire nel nostro team!

L'obiettivo principale di questo ruolo è essere responsabile della completa amministrazione delle buste paga in Europa e Canada (EU&I), lavorando a stretto contatto con fornitori esterni di buste paga e team finanziari locali. Il ruolo si concentra fortemente sulla revisione e convalida delle buste paga, sulla contabilità delle buste paga, sulle riconciliazioni dei conti, fungendo anche da supporto per la revisione delle buste paga interne svizzere.

Questo è un ruolo pratico di specialista senior per qualcuno che combina una forte esperienza in materia di buste paga con una solida conoscenza della contabilità delle buste paga e ama lavorare in un ambiente internazionale.

Responsabilità lavorative

• Gestire e coordinare le attività relative alle buste paga per i mercati assegnati, garantendo una consegna accurata, tempestiva e conforme delle buste paga in collaborazione con fornitori esterni di buste paga

• Preparare e fornire input accurati e tempestivi sulle buste paga ai fornitori di servizi di gestione stipendi esterni e rivedere e convalidare i risultati mensili sulle buste paga per i mercati assegnati

• Condurre revisioni mensili approfondite delle buste paga e garantire che tutte le buste paga assegnate vengano elaborate in modo tempestivo e accurato internamente presso la sede centrale e dai fornitori.

• Eseguire la convalida delle fatture e il monitoraggio dei pagamenti per i fornitori di gestione stipendi assegnati e/o affiliati locali, a seconda dei casi.

• Eseguire il giornale mensile delle buste paga e la riconciliazione dei conti (bilancio e profitti e perdite), comprese registrazioni aggiuntive in seguito all'allineamento con il team finanziario locale

• Agire come primo punto di contatto per le domande relative alle buste paga dei dipendenti e collaborare strettamente con le risorse umane e le finanze per risolvere le questioni relative alle buste paga.

• Garantire l'allineamento del reporting con quello finanziario, comprese le previsioni sui salari

• Preparare e rivedere i ratei mensili (compresi ferie, bonus, orario flessibile ecc.)

• Preparare la documentazione di audit relativa alle buste paga e fornire supporto per audit interni ed esterni e requisiti di legge locali.

• Supportare le implementazioni e le transizioni delle buste paga per nuovi paesi, persone giuridiche, fornitori di buste paga e cambiamenti di sistema.

• Promuovere il miglioramento continuo dei processi, dei controlli e della documentazione relativi alle buste paga e identificare in modo proattivo le opportunità di standardizzazione, automazione e maggiore efficienza.

• Eseguire e coordinare le attività di fine anno, inclusi certificati fiscali, allegati/integratori e dichiarazioni statutarie di fine anno alle autorità per i mercati interessati.

Requisiti del candidato

• Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel settore delle buste paga, preferibilmente in un ambiente multinazionale o internazionale, con forte esposizione al settore UE&I e alle buste paga svizzere

• Forte esperienza nella contabilità dei salari, comprese le registrazioni CoGe, i ratei, le riconciliazioni di stato patrimoniale e conto economico e l'analisi degli scostamenti (obbligatorio)

• Buona conoscenza delle normative fiscali relative ai salari, dei sistemi di previdenza sociale e dei benefici in UE&I e in Svizzera

• Comprovata esperienza pratica nella revisione, convalida e collaborazione delle buste paga con fornitori esterni di buste paga

• Competenze avanzate di Excel; SAP Payroll o sistemi simili sono un vantaggio

• Buona conoscenza dei processi di gestione delle retribuzioni end-to-end, comprese le interfacce, i controlli e l'integrazione finanziaria

• Forte mentalità analitica e strutturata con un elevato livello di accuratezza e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Approccio proattivo, pragmatico, orientato alla soluzione e al cliente con un forte senso di proprietà.

• Capacità di gestire e coordinare in modo indipendente più fornitori, scadenze, richieste e progetti contemporaneamente in un ambiente internazionale complesso

• Eccellenti capacità di gestione degli stakeholder, comunicazione e collaborazione interfunzionale.

• L'esperienza nella progettazione dei processi di gestione delle retribuzioni e nel miglioramento continuo costituisce un vantaggio.

• Ottima conoscenza della lingua inglese; Il tedesco e altre lingue sarebbero un vantaggio.

• Un ambiente collaborativo e orientato alla soluzione in cui puoi assumerti la responsabilità e avere un impatto

• Una cultura innovativa e aperta in un ambiente veramente multiculturale e internazionale

• Uno stipendio competitivo e vantaggi sociali interessanti

Wir suchen einen Senior Payroll Specialist (Schweiz, EU&I) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams!

Das Hauptaugenmerk dieser Rolle liegt auf der Verantwortung für die vollständige Verwaltung der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung in Europa und Kanada (EU&I) und in enger Zusammenarbeit mit externen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsanbietern und lokalen Finanzteams. Die Rolle konzentriert sich stark auf die Überprüfung und Validierung von Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen, die Lohnbuchhaltung und Kontoabstimmungen und fungiert gleichzeitig als Backup für die Überprüfung der schweizerischen internen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung.

Dies ist eine praxisorientierte Position als leitender Spezialist für jemanden, der ausgeprägte Fachkenntnisse in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung mit soliden Kenntnissen in der Lohn- und Gehaltsbuchhaltung kombiniert und Freude daran hat, in einem internationalen Umfeld zu arbeiten.

Aufgabenbereiche

• Verwalten und koordinieren Sie die Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsaktivitäten für zugewiesene Märkte und stellen Sie in Zusammenarbeit mit externen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsanbietern eine genaue, zeitnahe und konforme Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung sicher

• Bereiten Sie genaue und zeitnahe Gehaltsabrechnungseingaben vor und stellen Sie sie externen Lohnabrechnungsanbietern zur Verfügung. Überprüfen und validieren Sie die monatlichen Gehaltsabrechnungsausgaben für zugewiesene Märkte

• Führen Sie monatliche eingehende Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen durch und stellen Sie sicher, dass alle zugewiesenen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungen zeitnah und korrekt intern in der Zentrale und bei den Anbietern verarbeitet werden.

• Führen Sie gegebenenfalls eine Rechnungsvalidierung und Zahlungsverfolgung für zugewiesene Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsanbieter und/oder lokale Tochtergesellschaften durch.

• Führen Sie ein monatliches Lohnjournal und einen Kontoabgleich (Bilanz und Gewinn- und Verlustrechnung) durch, einschließlich zusätzlicher Buchungen nach Abstimmung mit dem lokalen Finanzteam

• Sie fungieren als erste Anlaufstelle für Mitarbeiteranfragen im Zusammenhang mit der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung und arbeiten bei der Lösung von Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsfragen eng mit der Personal- und Finanzabteilung zusammen.

• Stellen Sie die Abstimmung der Berichterstattung mit der Finanzabteilung sicher, einschließlich der Gehaltsabrechnungsprognosen

• Erstellen und überprüfen Sie monatliche Rückstellungen (einschließlich Urlaub, Bonus, Gleitzeit usw.)

• Bereiten Sie die Prüfungsdokumentation im Zusammenhang mit der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung vor und bieten Sie Unterstützung bei internen und externen Prüfungen sowie lokalen gesetzlichen Anforderungen.

• Unterstützen Sie Implementierungen und Übergänge der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung für neue Länder, juristische Personen, Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsanbieter und Systemänderungen.

• Fördern Sie die kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsprozesse, -kontrollen und -dokumentation und identifizieren Sie proaktiv Möglichkeiten für Standardisierung, Automatisierung und Effizienzsteigerung.

• Führen und koordinieren Sie Aufgaben zum Jahresende, einschließlich Steuerbescheinigungen, Anhänge/Ergänzungen und gesetzliche Jahresenderklärungen an Behörden für die betroffenen Märkte.

Anforderungen des Kandidaten

• Mindestens 5 Jahre einschlägige Erfahrung in der Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung, vorzugsweise in einem länderübergreifenden oder internationalen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsumfeld, mit starkem Bezug zu EU&I und der Schweizer Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnung

• Umfangreiches Fachwissen in der Lohnbuchhaltung, einschließlich Hauptbuchbuchungen, Rückstellungen, Bilanz- und GuV-Kontenabstimmungen sowie Abweichungsanalysen (obligatorisch)

• Gutes Verständnis der lohnbezogenen Steuervorschriften, Sozialversicherungssysteme und Leistungen in EU&I und der Schweiz

• Nachgewiesene praktische Erfahrung in der Überprüfung, Validierung und Zusammenarbeit von Gehaltsabrechnungen mit externen Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsanbietern

• Fortgeschrittene Excel-Kenntnisse; Von Vorteil sind SAP Payroll oder vergleichbare Systeme

• Gutes Verständnis der gesamten Lohn- und Gehaltsabrechnungsprozesse, einschließlich Schnittstellen und Kontrollen sowie Finanzintegration

• Ausgeprägte analytische und strukturierte Denkweise mit einem hohen Maß an Genauigkeit und Liebe zum Detail.

• Proaktiver, pragmatischer, lösungs- und kundenorientierter Ansatz mit ausgeprägtem Eigenverantwortungsgefühl.

Idorsia Ltd veut plus – Nous avons plus d’idées, nous voyons plus d’opportunités et nous voulons aider plus de patients. Pour y parvenir, nous ferons d’Idorsia une société biopharmaceutique leader, dotée d’un solide noyau scientifique.

Basée près de Bâle, en Suisse – un pôle biotechnologique européen – Idorsia est spécialisée dans la découverte, le développement et la commercialisation de petites molécules pour transformer l’horizon des options thérapeutiques. Idorsia possède un héritage de 25 ans dans la découverte de médicaments, un large portefeuille de médicaments innovants en préparation, une équipe expérimentée de professionnels couvrant toutes les disciplines, du laboratoire au chevet, et des opérations commerciales en Europe et en Amérique du Nord – la constellation idéale pour proposer des médicaments innovants aux patients.

Idorsia est cotée à la SIX Swiss Exchange (symbole boursier : IDIA) en juin 2017 et compte plus de 750 spécialistes hautement qualifiés qui se consacrent à la réalisation de nos objectifs ambitieux.

Nous recherchons un spécialiste senior de la paie (Suisse, UE&I) pour rejoindre notre équipe !

L'objectif principal de ce rôle est d'être responsable de l'administration complète de la paie en Europe et au Canada (EU&I), en travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les prestataires de paie externes et les équipes financières locales. Le rôle se concentre fortement sur l'examen et la validation de la paie, la comptabilité des salaires, les rapprochements de comptes, tout en agissant également en tant que remplaçant pour l'examen de la paie interne suisse.

Il s'agit d'un poste de spécialiste senior pratique pour quelqu'un qui combine une solide expertise en matière de paie avec de solides connaissances en comptabilité de paie et qui aime travailler dans un environnement international.

Responsabilités du poste

• Gérer et coordonner les activités de paie pour les marchés assignés, en garantissant une livraison de paie précise, rapide et conforme en collaboration avec les prestataires de paie externes.

• Préparer et fournir des entrées de paie précises et en temps opportun aux prestataires de paie externes, et examiner et valider les sorties de paie mensuelles pour les marchés assignés.

• Effectuer des examens mensuels approfondis de la paie et garantir que toutes les paies attribuées sont traitées en temps opportun et avec précision en interne au siège et par les fournisseurs.

• Effectuer la validation des factures et le suivi des paiements pour les prestataires de paie désignés et/ou les filiales locales, le cas échéant.

• Effectuer le journal de paie mensuel et le rapprochement des comptes (bilan et P&L), y compris les publications supplémentaires après alignement avec l'équipe Finance locale.

• Agir en tant que premier point de contact pour les requêtes liées à la paie des employés et collaborer étroitement avec les RH et les Finances pour résoudre les problèmes de paie.

• Assurer l'alignement des rapports avec la Finance, y compris les prévisions de paie

• Préparer et examiner les cumuls mensuels (y compris les vacances, les primes, les horaires flexibles, etc.)

• Préparer la documentation d'audit liée à la paie et fournir un soutien aux audits internes et externes ainsi qu'aux exigences légales locales.

• Soutenir les mises en œuvre et les transitions de paie pour les nouveaux pays, entités juridiques, fournisseurs de paie et les changements de système.

• Favoriser l'amélioration continue des processus, des contrôles et de la documentation de paie et identifier de manière proactive les opportunités de standardisation, d'automatisation et d'efficacité accrue.

• Effectuer et coordonner les tâches de fin d'année, y compris les attestations fiscales, les pièces jointes/suppléments et les déclarations statutaires de fin d'année aux autorités pour les marchés concernés.

Exigences du candidat

• Minimum 5 ans d'expérience pertinente en paie, de préférence dans un environnement de paie multi-pays ou international, avec une forte exposition à la paie UE&I et suisse.

• Solide expertise en comptabilité de paie, y compris les écritures GL, les régularisations, les rapprochements de bilans et de comptes P&L et l'analyse des écarts (obligatoire)

• Bonne compréhension des réglementations fiscales liées à la paie, des systèmes de sécurité sociale et des avantages sociaux dans l'UE&I et en Suisse.

• Expérience pratique avérée en matière d'examen, de validation et de collaboration avec des prestataires de paie externes.

• Compétences avancées en Excel ; SAP Payroll ou des systèmes similaires constituent un avantage

• Bonne compréhension des processus de paie de bout en bout, y compris les interfaces et les contrôles ainsi que l'intégration financière.

• Fort esprit analytique et structuré avec un haut niveau de précision et d'attention aux détails.

• Approche proactive, pragmatique, orientée solutions et client avec un fort sentiment d'appropriation.

• Capacité à gérer et coordonner de manière indépendante et simultanée plusieurs fournisseurs, délais, demandes et projets dans un environnement international complexe.

• Excellentes compétences en gestion des parties prenantes, en communication et en collaboration interfonctionnelle.

• Une expérience dans la conception de processus de paie et dans l'amélioration continue est un avantage.

• Maîtrise de l'anglais ; L'allemand et d'autres langues seraient un atout.

• Une culture innovante et ouverte dans un environnement véritablement multiculturel et international

• Un salaire compétitif et des avantages sociaux attractifs
